annotations.title: Change a clip's frame and layout

description: Use this when the person wants to change how a made clip's picture is framed, anything the Slice editor's Frame tab and Layouts do, with no render. aspect: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9, 3:4, source (ask the person which shape first). layout: follow-speaker, follow-both, two-people, face-on-top, face-corner, speaker-slides, fill, whole-blur, whole-black (list_styles kind "layout" says what each is; split screens are 9:16 only). fit (fill or whole) and background (black or blur); crop {scale 1-5, x, y} moves and zooms the picture; moves [{at_seconds, scale, x, y}] reframe part-way through ([] removes them); split {share, swap, border, corner_size} adjusts a split screen; follow speaker, both or off (Slice finds who is talking, as the editor's Follow the speaker does); logo "brand", false or {path, x, y, width, opacity}; end_frame "brand", false or {path, kind, duration_seconds}. Saves the clip only: the person sees it in Slice and can undo.

clip_id.description: The clip's id (from get_episode, get_job or the Slice link).

crop.description: scale 1 fills the frame, up to 5; x and y -1 to 1 move the picture (0 is centred).

end_frame.description: "brand" (the account's end card), false (none on this clip), or { "path", "kind": "image" | "video", "duration_seconds" }.

logo.description: "brand" (the account's logo), false (none), or { "path" (a file in this account), "x", "y" (0-1, its centre), "width" (0.04-0.6), "opacity" (0-1) }.

moves.description: Camera moves: from at_seconds on, the picture is framed like this. Replaces the clip's moves.

name: set_frame

open_in_slice.description: The clip in the Slice editor, where the person sees the change.

title: Change a clip's frame and layout
